occ-01-c2.text: Wouter J. Hanegraaff and Joyce Pijnenburg (eds.) (2009). Hermes in the Academy: Ten Years' Study of Western Esotericism at the University of Amsterdam. Amsterdam University Press.
occ-01-c2.quote: The great strength of this approach is that it does not define esotericism in terms of its contents
occ-01-c2.claim: this 'rejected knowledge' framing explains it without forcing them into a single doctrinal essence
